reason: This is the only offered action, and it follows the lane-born stars into the returning galaxy.
expectation: I expect the stars to pass into or through the galaxy's outskirts, though their eventual paths are uncertain.

effect: The lane-born stars pass through the returning galaxy without colliding like their parent gas clouds, completing the chapter’s goal.
reaction: The contrast between the stars and their parent clouds was satisfying, though the outcome was close to what I expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the stars across the galaxy was worthwhile because it brought the earlier gas collision back into view and showed what changed when some of that gas became stars.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter’s only decision offered no meaningful choice, so the action itself was less engaging than its explanation.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprised me; the stars’ passage was broadly what I expected.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the only action directly addressed the stated goal.

continue.text: I might continue for the interconnected cosmic story, though I would hope for more decisions than this chapter offered.
